meta: 111 AI slash commands, career fit and weighted gap scorecards, a ranked Job Match Radar that scores role fit and interview likelihood against live job-board searches, enterprise portfolio, program, project, C-suite playbook generators and an HTML audit lab that builds industry-specific prompt packs, synthetic demos, and interactive dashboard specifications.
promiseText: Add job links or descriptions plus your résumé and cover letter — as files or pasted text. The studio reads them in this browser, scores the evidence match, charts where you are strong and where you are thin, drafts a tailored cover letter and a 30-60-90 project plan, and builds job-search links. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
